description: This file defines the OAuth2TokensController class, which manages OAuth2 token revocation and mass update operations within the SuiteCRM platform. It includes a method for revoking tokens either in bulk or individually.

classes.name: OAuth2TokensController
classes.description: Controller class for managing OAuth2 tokens, specifically for mass revocation and updates.

methods.name: action_massupdate
methods.description: Handles mass updating of OAuth2 tokens, primarily for revoking tokens either for the entire list or specific selected tokens.
